metaDescription: Boston Terrier vaccine schedule with core ages in weeks. Set reminders so Boston Terrier boosters are not missed.

bodySections.heading: Why timing matters for this schedule
paragraphs: Why timing is non-negotiable for Boston Terriers: each booster lands after the previous dose’s immunology window, usually every 2–4 weeks, until the Boston Terrier series closes at about 16 weeks.
Size class small does not invent new viruses for the Boston Terrier, but it does change crate fit, blood-draw ease, and how early you lock travel relative to the final DA2PP / DHPP booster.
Flag patellar luxation at Boston Terrier vaccine checkups so the puppy’s chart accumulates breed-relevant context, not just sticker dates.
When the Boston Terrier series is complete, switch reminders to adult booster cadence instead of deleting the vaccine thread entirely.

bodySections.heading: If a dose is missed or delayed
paragraphs: Delayed Boston Terrier boosters usually need one well-timed catch-up, not a homemade double dose, because spacing rules protect the puppy and guilt math does not.
Bring prior dates for every Boston Terrier row (8, 12, 16, 16 weeks on this page’s plan) so clinics can decide whether an extra DA2PP / DHPP booster is required based on gap length and age.
If rabies was the missed Boston Terrier item, legal and boarding consequences stack on top of medical ones — restore compliance before the next Boston Terrier kennel reservation.
PetClues should hold both the new Boston Terrier due date and the certificate photo so household members stop arguing about which fridge sticky note is current.

faqs.question: When does the Boston Terrier core vaccine series usually finish?
faqs.answer: This breed record completes core vaccines around 16 weeks of age, with rabies timed per local law. Your clinic may adjust intervals for the individual puppy.

faqs.question: What should I do if my Boston Terrier misses a booster?
faqs.answer: Contact your veterinarian for a catch-up plan instead of restarting or skipping ahead. Keep prior dates handy and limit high-risk exposure until the series is current again.

faqs.question: Where can I read Boston Terrier health context beyond vaccines?
faqs.answer: See the Boston Terrier adult health guide for breed predispositions such as brachycephalic obstructive airway syndrome (boas), then bring those notes to wellness and vaccine visits.
